The mvet is a chordophone of the Fang of Central Africa, of the bar-zither family, Hornbostel–Sachs number 311. It looks like the Mande kora but is larger and simpler, based on a palm or bamboo tube one to two metres long, usually fitted with three gourd resonators; a vertical bridge at the centre divides four or five gut or metal strings, and both sides of the bridge can be played. It is held horizontally against the chest and the arms open and close the central resonator. It can be played solo and also accompanies songs or poems, with subjects that include epics, war songs, ritual, philosophy and worldly knowledge; it holds an important place in the epic-singer tradition of the Fang and related peoples, and at the end of the twentieth century it also became an important instrument of bikutsi music.
初學 Mvet 時，先將管狀琴身橫置胸前，以手臂動作開合中央共鳴器；彈奏時在中央: When learning the mvet, first lay the tubular body horizontally across the chest and open and close the central resonator with the arms; then, to play, pluck the four or five gut or metal strings on either side of the central vertical bridge so that they sound. Begin by practising short solo notes and then add a song or poem, since the source says it can be played solo or as accompaniment. The instrument is the bar zither used by the Fang, Hornbostel–Sachs 311, found in Gabon, Cameroon, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, São Tomé and Equatorial Guinea.
姆維特琴擁有溫潤而深邃的音色，帶有濃厚的非洲民族特色。其音域寬廣，可演奏低沉的基: The mvet has a warm, deep timbre with a strong African character. Its range is wide, from a low fundamental to a bright treble, with good control of pitch. Because it is fitted with three gourd resonators the sound has rich harmonic resonance, producing a warm and penetrating effect. Compared with the kora, the mvet is fuller and steadier, with a deeper resonance; compared with the harp its texture is somewhat rougher and more natural, with a percussive feel. Plucking gut or metal strings gives the instrument flexible expression: it can play soft melodies and also produce a crisp, forceful plucked attack, which suits complex folk music and narrative song.
